description_en: Calls the eKYC global anti-spoofing callback operation
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl fraud-result-call-back --certify-id shs2b27333914876c01de4cb22f5841f --result-code PASS --verify-deploy-env production --ext-params example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: FraudResultCallBack

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for identity verification, which corresponds to the verifyId of Ant
parameters.help_zh: 实人认证唯一标识,对应蚂蚁的verifyId
parameters.name: certify_id

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether the anti-spoofing check is passed. Valid values:
- PASS: Passed.
- REJECT: Not passed
parameters.help_zh:
防伪是否通过
- PASS (通过)
- REJECT (不通过)
parameters.name: result_code

parameters.help_en:
The environment routing parameter. Valid values:
- staging: staging environment
- production: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
环境路由参数
- staging (预发环境)
- production (线上环境)
parameters.name: verify_deploy_env

parameters.help_en: The extended parameters, in JSON string format
parameters.name: ext_params
